note: First version: the 24 dp circle that marks something done or not, which layouts wrote as an outlined ring (not done) and a filled circle with a tick (done)

component.doc: A 24 dp circle that says whether something is done: an empty ring outlined in the muted text colour while it isn't, a filled accent circle with a tick once it is. Put it at the start of a row (a to-do, a reminder, a step), usually in a core://Tappable that ticks the item, and pick done from the item's field with two core://Conditional. For a whole row that ticks a field use @core/checkable_row.

params.name: done
params.doc: Draw the filled circle with a tick (true) instead of the empty ring.

examples.note: a reminder not done yet, in a Tappable that marks it done
